{{Quote|These must be trophies taken from the Jedi he's murdered.|[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]], on the trophies in Grievous's castle, including Neebo's lightsaber|<ref name="Lair">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref>}}
'''Neebo''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Neebo went missing on a [[Mission to the moons of Sanjin/Legends|mission]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Sanjin/Legends|Sanjin]], and her [[Neebo's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was later found by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in the [[Grievous's castle/Legends|castle]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], a Jedi [[Death/Legends|killer]].

==Biography==
Neebo was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual who lived during the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and eventually reached the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Sometime before fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto's]] [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|mission]] to the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon of Vassek]]<ref name="Episode Guide Lair of Grievous" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Neebo went on a [[Mission to the moons of Sanjin/Legends|mission]] to protect refugees on the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the<ref name="Episode Guide Lair of Grievous" /> [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sanjin/Legends|Sanjin]]. Neebo went missing in the conflict, and Fisto later found her [[Neebo's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in the trophy room of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]<ref name="Episode Guide Lair of Grievous" />&mdash;who often collected the weapons of Jedi he had [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="Lair" />&mdash;during his infiltration of the [[Grievous's castle/Legends|General's castle]] on the third moon of [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]]. Fisto examined Neebo's weapon and then went on to [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] Grievous.<ref name="Episode Guide Lair of Grievous" />

==Powers and abilities==
Neebo was a Force-sensitive Jedi Master. In [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], she wielded a lightsaber.<ref name="Episode Guide Lair of Grievous" />

==Behind the scenes==
Neebo was first mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released on [[December 9]], [[2008]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|366|Neebo}}</ref> She was later referenced in the corresponding [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide]] for "[[Lair of Grievous]]," part of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[December 12]], 2008.<ref name="Episode Guide Lair of Grievous" />
